messages.author: bob
messages.content: bulk import of 5k docs and search index is throwing lock errors in waves

messages.author: alice
messages.content: they all retry at the same instant — classic thundering herd, no backoff

messages.author: carol
messages.content: worse: the ones that lose the lock just raise and the doc never gets indexed. silent data loss

messages.author: bob
messages.content: we need jittered backoff + defer-and-reschedule when the writer lock is busy
